title: The First Descendant
description: A free-to-play third-person cooperative looter shooter in which Descendants use distinct abilities and weapons to defend Ingris, collect equipment and tackle large bosses with up to four players.

player_sentiment.summary: Sampled user reviews across multiple updates praise combat, visuals and build progression, while others criticize repetitive grinding, monetization and mission variety; experiences differ by version and player.
positives: Rewarding builds and equipment progression for some
negatives: Repetitive farming and limited mission variety
Monetization and time demands draw criticism
